Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personalarbeit nicht delegiert, sondern macht: von der Stellenanzeige bis zum Zeugnis, selbstständig und mit Tempo. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg und Berlin sowie in Marokko. Wir konzipieren und realisieren geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprachkurse und Weiterbildungen – für Privat- wie Firmenkunden, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Worum es geht Wir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region. In this role, you will Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland Create and embed a team playbook

Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. jobs.title: Growth
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE. You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show. Your First Six Months Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Radar
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team, you own the mechanical integration of our radar systems, for both airborne payloads and ground-based platforms. You lead each subsystem from design through prototyping, testing and production, with a strong focus on weight, cost and performance. You work at the intersection of AI, robotics and defense autonomy, turning research into hardware deployed in the field. Responsibilities Design and prototype complex subsystems for airborne and ground radar platforms, applying design-to-cost and design-for-automation principles. Own the thermal, mass, cost (COGS) and environmental sealing (IP rating) budgets of your subsystems. Manage EMC and RF isolation constraints in close coordination with the Radar and Radio teams. Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices. The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more. Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team.
